task:
System Map: hierarchy-aware schematic layout — stars, barycentres, planets and nested moons grouped by known parent links (map review finding M13). apps/web only; no API change.

VERIFIED ON MAIN (0f6dc228): `apps/web/src/lib/spatial/system-scene.ts` `buildSystemScene` ranks bodies by `distanceFromArrivalLs`, lays them on a flat plane with a logarithmic radius and a golden-angle (2.3999 rad) spiral from one shared origin; unknown or non-positive distances sit at the origin; moons are spread around the system as if they were independent planets. The bodies API already supplies `direct_parent_body_id` (`SystemDetailBody` in `apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts` maps it from `direct_parent_body_pk`), `body_type` (star | planet | barycentre | belt_cluster), `is_main_star`, `semi_major_axis_km`, `radius_km` and `distance_from_arrival_ls`. PR 986 (M12) adds `bodyClass` and body-family materials on the same scene builder; build on main after it merges, or on main now and expect a small merge.

WHAT TO DO:
1. Build a tree from `direct_parent_body_id` (roots: bodies with no parent, usually the main star or a barycentre; unknown parent → a visible "unattached" group, never silently re-parented). Layout: each parent gets its own orbit plane region; children are placed around their parent at a schematic radius that preserves ORDER by `semi_major_axis_km` when known (fallback: `distance_from_arrival_ls`, then name), log-scaled so inner and outer bodies both read; moons orbit their planet in a tighter ring, scaled so a planet's moon ring never crosses a sibling planet's ring; barycentres are drawn as a small cross/marker with their member stars placed around them. Keep the current logarithmic body display size rule and the flat (non-animated) schematic: this is a legible diagram, not an orrery.
2. Draw faint orbit guides (one ring per parent) and parent–child links only for selected/hovered bodies; keep the existing selection and picking identity (body key) unchanged. Stations stay attached to their body when the detail already resolves a body; unresolved stations stay in the existing "unresolved" list.
3. Honesty: label the layout "schematic; order by known orbital distance; moons grouped by known parent" in the existing truth note; bodies with unknown parent or distance get an explicit "position unknown" marker treatment and are listed in the legend as unplaced, never put at the star's position.
4. Deterministic: the same input always yields the same positions (sort ties by body key). Bound the work to O(n log n).

TESTS (vitest): tree construction with a Sol-like fixture (star → planets → moons, one barycentre pair, one body with unknown parent) asserting group membership and that no moon shares a radius band with a sibling planet; order preserved by semi-major axis and the fallbacks; unknown parent → unattached group and the unplaced marker; determinism; the existing scene tests updated where they pinned the flat spiral, and said so in CHANGES.md; adapter NullEngine test that orbit guides exist per parent and links render only for the selected body; component test for the truth note text.

VALIDATION: in apps/web `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`. CHANGES.md: one dated 2026-11-02 entry; note the visible change needs Product E2E/visual validation before production promotion and is not deployed.
